Name: DragonBeans Trinkers(Arknights)
Author: EndlessPathB103
Description:
[b][color=#d4d4d8]1. 绩泡泡[/color][/b]
[color=#D4D4D8]【午商梭】受到攻击时给250~1250G，7秒冷却。
[b]Ji Bean[/b]
[Merchant Shuttle] When attacked, grants 250–1250 G, 7s cooldown.
[/color]
[line]
[color=#D4D4D8][b]2. 均泡泡[/b]
【得胜琴】杀死怪物后，随机给予一枚宝石。
[b]Jun Bean[/b]
[Victory Zither] Upon killing a monster, randomly gives one gem.
[/color]
[line]
[color=#D4D4D8][b]3. 令泡泡[/b]
【宁作吾】每10秒对敌方进行攻击，并造成5秒束缚。另附有常态buff：攻击力+20，防御力+40。
[b]Ling Bean[/b]
[Be Myself] Attacks enemies every 10s, binding them for 5s. Also provides a permanent buff: ATK +20, DEF +40.
[/color]
[line]
[color=#D4D4D8][b]4. 年泡泡[/b]
【铜印】每次受到攻击时防御力+130，并对目标造成30~50的伤害以及使其失去特殊能力5秒。
[b]Nian Bean[/b]
[Copper Seal] Each time you are hit, DEF +130, and deals 30–50 damage to the target, also stripping their special abilities for 5s.
[/color]
[line]
[color=#D4D4D8][b]5. 朔泡泡[/b]
【说话搞么子】每200秒朝敌方投掷一个搞么子龙泡泡，基础伤害500~750，索敌范围：64像素，爆炸半径：20像素，可穿透3次，眩晕敌人20秒。
[b]Shuo Bean[/b]
[Say What?] Every 200s, throws a 'Say What?' Dragon Bean at enemies. Base damage 500–750, search range 64px, blast radius 20px, penetrates 3 times, stuns enemies for 20s.
[/color]
[line]
[color=#D4D4D8][b]6. 黍泡泡[/b]
【化被草木】每200秒恢复180的生命值与体力值，收集所有采集物。
[b]Shu Bean[/b]
[Turning the Grass] Every 200s, restores 180 HP and stamina, and collects all harvestables.
[/color]
[line]
[color=#D4D4D8][b]7. 望泡泡[/b]
【天下劫】每5秒朝敌方投掷一个棋子，每100秒朝敌方释放【连星】：对16像素内的敌人造成1000~1500伤害并产生爆炸。
[b]Wang Bean[/b]
[World's End] Throws a chess piece at enemies every 5s. Every 100s, releases [Linked Stars]: deals 1000–1500 damage to enemies within 16px and causes an explosion.
[/color]
[line]
[color=#D4D4D8][b]8. 夕泡泡[/b]
【写意胜形】攻击时攻击力+50，每6秒在目标位置召唤一个持续25秒的阿咬。
[b]Dusk Bean[/b]
[Freehand] When attacking, ATK +50, and every 6s summons an A-Yo at the target location that lasts 25s.
[/color]
[line]
[color=#D4D4D8][b]9. 易泡泡[/b]
【承梁】每200秒召唤两个“梁”，并进行爆炸。【采莲】每100秒进行爆炸式挖矿。另附有常态buff：采矿等级+8，防御力+40。
[b]Yi Bean[/b]
[Support Beam] Every 200s, summons two 'Beams' that explode. [Lotus Picking] Every 100s, performs explosive mining. Also provides permanent buff: Mining Level +8, DEF +40.
[/color]
[line]
[color=#D4D4D8][b]10. 方泡泡[/b]
【万灵方】走路时，自动恢复1%的生命值与体力值。
[b]Fang Bean[/b]
[Panacea] While walking, automatically recovers 1% HP and stamina.
[/color]
[line]
[color=#D4D4D8][b]11. 余泡泡[/b]
【今日做东】每次受到攻击时生命上限+70，防御力+70，并对目标造成攻击力为10~100的灼燃损伤。
[b]Yu Bean[/b]
[Host's Duty] Each time you are hit, Max HP +70, DEF +70, and deals 10–100 burn damage to the target.
[/color]
[line]
[color=#D4D4D8][b]12. 颉泡泡[/b]
【撼山河】每400秒朝敌方释放【不寐】：？？？？？，？？，？？？？。
[b]Jie Bean[/b]
[Shake Mountains and Rivers] Every 400s, releases [Sleepless] on enemies: ?????, ??, ????[/color]
